title: SymbolicSystem: ObjectConnectorUser on markers of user bodies and of the ground, with rotations
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG12.51.4: the connector markers BodyPosition and BodyRigid on ObjectUserBody (by its symbolic position, rotation and Jacobian functions) and on the ground, the rotations and angular velocities when the connector requests Orientation, the forces and torques by J_pos^T f + J_rot^T m, the exact Jacobian by Diff of the recordings; the joints and constraints follow.
releaseNotes: exudyn.misc.symbolicSystem.SymbolicSystem takes ObjectConnectorUser on MarkerBodyPosition and MarkerBodyRigid of user bodies and of the ground, with the rotations and angular velocities when the connector requests Orientation; the forces and torques act through the Jacobians of the body, the Jacobian of the residual is exact by Diff of the recordings; symbolicUserRigidBodiesTest.py: SolveExplicit and SolveGeneralizedAlpha equal to SolveDynamic
